# Mohammed Fakhri

> Mohammed Fakhri is a software developer based in Iraq, working as a Full-stack Developer at QiCard, with 7+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and implementing applications, mainly with C#, .NET, and ASP.NET.

Mohammed's work centres on full-stack and back-end web development on the Microsoft stack (.NET Core, .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, SQL Server). Past roles have covered requirements analysis, technical documentation, system design, and leading and mentoring development teams. Education includes a bachelor's degree in computer science from the University of Baghdad and an MBA in progress at Quantic School of Business and Technology.

Mohammed combines engineering depth with business training, which suits roles that sit between technology and the business: technical lead, solution architect, product-minded senior developer, or tech business roles. Experience already includes working with senior stakeholders to turn business requirements into technical specifications (Global Carrier), analysing requirements and estimating effort with agile methods (EarthLink Telecommunications), and leading and mentoring a development team. The MBA adds formal training in strategy, management, and business decision-making, so technical choices can be weighed against cost, value, and business goals, and explained clearly to non-technical decision makers.
